acceptance_criteria: AC1: test/fixtures/simulation/{swiftroute,vortex,meridian}/ contains all 12 company/org/process YAML files ported from R-Co's tests/simulation/companies/, with actor_id values unchanged from the R-Co originals -- verified by a diff-style comparison test

AC4: Letflow.Simulation.Runner executes a minimal one-step api-via scenario end to end against a real running instance (real HTTP through Letflow.Router, not a mocked handler) and evaluates at least one instance_state-method expected outcome by querying actual instance state afterward

oq_resolutions.OQ-1: Tenant.t() has NO prefix/schema-name field at all (confirmed by reading lib/letflow/identity/tenant.ex's schema: id, slug, display_name, status, idp_realm_id, timestamps only). The schema name is separate state owned by Letflow.TenantProvisioning (Registration.schema_name / schema_name_for_tenant/1). Seed derives prefix via TenantProvisioning.schema_name_for_tenant(tenant.id) wherever needed -- documented in seed.ex's moduledoc as a design/implementation discrepancy.
oq_resolutions.OQ-2 (HTTP action -> context-function ma: Resolved concretely only for this requirement's one minimal scenario: 'POST /api/v1/instances' -> Letflow.Engine.create/2 via Letflow.Routers.Instances' handle_create/1, response {instance_id, status, created_at}. General action-string parsing implemented as method+path split + Letflow.Router.call/2 dispatch (Runner.parse_action!/1) -- REQ-206/207/208 extend real action coverage as their own scenario corpus is ported, per the design's own deferral.
oq_resolutions.OQ-3 (yaml_elixir scalar-coercion fideli: Verified informally against this session's own synthetic fixtures (strings, nested maps/lists, no YAML 1.1 on/off/yes/no boolean fields present in any fixture) -- all fields round-tripped as expected string/map/list types in fixture_shape_test.exs and the Seed/Runner tests. NOT verified against R-Co's real fixture content (unreachable, per the environment-constraint section above) -- if a future real port introduces YAML boolean-like scalars, this needs re-verification then.

additional_deviations_from_design_record: get_by_username/2 and username_unique_conflict?/1 (design cited as callable) are actually `defp` (module-private) in lib/letflow/identity.ex -- substituted with Letflow.Identity.list_users/2's public :search filter + client-side exact match, same idiom already settled for seed_groups/2's OQ-2 (list_groups + client-side match). Documented in seed.ex moduledoc.

Engine.count_instances_by_status/1 takes only opts: [prefix: ...], no process_id scoping (design implied per-process scoping) -- Runner's :no_pending_instances precondition is tenant-wide, not per-process. Documented in runner.ex moduledoc.
§6 instance_state's real backing function is Letflow.Instances.get_by_id/2, not a function on Letflow.Engine itself. Documented in runner.ex moduledoc.
§6 task_assigned compares against Task.t()'s real assignee_type/assignee_ref fields (no single 'assignee' field exists). Documented in runner.ex moduledoc.

Scenario.step() gained an 'actor' field beyond the design's literal table (via/action/params/produces) -- necessary plumbing since real HTTP dispatch needs a caller identity and the design deferred this. Documented in scenario struct moduledoc (test/support/simulation/runner.ex).
result.security_review_routing_note: ELIXIR-DEV's own read: this change is test-support code (test/support/simulation/, test/fixtures/simulation/, test/letflow/simulation/) that EXERCISES real tenant-provisioning/identity/definition/instance context functions (Letflow.Identity.create_tenant/1, Letflow.TenantOnboarding.provision_and_migrate/1, Letflow.Identity.create_user/2, Letflow.Identity.create_token/3, real HTTP through Letflow.Router.call/2 with a real API-token bearer credential) but ships no production code path -- nothing under lib/letflow/ changed except mix.exs's deps/0 (a test-only dependency addition). Per CLAUDE.md's roster table, SECURITY-REVIEWER gates 'tenant-data-path changes' -- this touches tenant-data *paths* (real provisioning, real credential issuance/verification) even though it is test-only code, and per this project's redundancy principle ('every producing step has a validating step') ELIXIR-DEV should not decide this gate is skippable. Routing to SECURITY-REVIEWER per the workflow's normal Step 2b; SECURITY-REVIEWER should make the final call on whether test-support-only code touching these paths needs the same INV-1..INV-8 scrutiny as production code (this session's own read: yes for INV-4 -- plaintext API tokens are handled in test code (runner_test.exs setup) exactly once, held only in local variables, never logged or persisted beyond the test's own on_exit teardown, matching the production create_token/3 discipline; no other INV appears implicated since no new production code exists).
